name: @youraitools/plugin-x402-tools
description: elizaOS plugin: pay-per-call x402 tools for agents. OFAC address screen (PayGuard), Base token safety check (TokenVerdict), Hyperliquid smart-money positioning (SmartPerps), paid-API finder (ToolPick), web page to Markdown (WebRead), prompt-injection scan (InjectScan). USDC per call, no custody.

YOURAITOOLS_CREDITS_KEY.description: Optional prepaid credits key (https://api.youraitools.co/credits/). Without it (and without an x402-paying fetch) actions report the 402 price instead of running.
